definitions.full: H5335. Netsiach נְצִיחַ proper name, masculine head of a family of Nethinim Ezra 2:54 ( ᵐ5 Νασους , A Νεθιε ) = Neh 7:56 ᵐ5 Ασεια , A Νεισεια ; ᵐ5 L Νεσια in both.
